sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加利福尼亚州的一个葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达（Ada）。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 然而，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“罪案档案呈现”推出的全新系列，现已上线，各大播客平台均可收听。

sentences.en: Hey, guess what?
sentences.zh: 嘿，你猜怎么着？

sentences.en: I found a cat.
sentences.zh: 我捡到了一只猫。

sentences.en: No way.
sentences.zh: 不会吧。

sentences.en: Yep, 12 years ago at a pet shelter.
sentences.zh: 真的，12年前在一家宠物收容所。

sentences.en: She's been at my house ever since.
sentences.zh: 从那以后它就一直待在我家。

sentences.en: Keep your cat safe at home.
sentences.zh: 把你的猫安全养在家里。

sentences.en: They'll live 70% longer on average.
sentences.zh: 它们的平均寿命能延长70%。

sentences.en: A message from RSPCA NSW with support from the Environmental TruSt.
sentences.zh: 新南威尔士州皇家防止虐待动物协会（RSPCA NSW）携手环境信托基金（Environmental Trust）共同发布。

sentences.en: Our episodes deal with serious and often distressing incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们的节目涉及严重且通常令人痛心的事件。

sentences.en: If you feel at any time you need support, please contact your local crisis centre.
sentences.zh: 如果您在任何时候觉得需要支持，请联系您当地的危机干预中心。

sentences.en: For suggested phone numbers for confidential support, please see the show notes for this episode on your app, or on our website.
sentences.zh: 有关保密支持的建议电话号码，请查看您使用的应用程序上的本集节目简介，或访问我们的网站。

sentences.en: Christy Marceau was abruptly awoken by the sharp ringing of her family's telephone.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂·马索（Christy Marceau）被家中急促刺耳的电话铃声猛然惊醒。

sentences.en: The 18-year-old had been sleeping in.
sentences.zh: 这位18岁的姑娘一直在睡懒觉。

sentences.en: It was 10am on Tuesday, September 6, 2011, and she didn't need to be anywhere that morning.
sentences.zh: 那是2011年9月6日星期二上午10点，那天早上她不需要去任何地方。

sentences.en: Christy was nearing the end of her first year at New Zealand's Auckland University of Technology, where she was studying events management.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂当时正读完新西兰奥克兰理工大学的第一年，主修活动管理专业。

sentences.en: Her dream was to have her own events company by the age of 30.
sentences.zh: 她的梦想是在30岁时拥有自己的活动策划公司。

sentences.en: For now, she was still living in the family home where she'd grown up, in the suburb of Hillcrest on the city's north shore.
sentences.zh: 目前，她仍然住在自己长大的家中，位于该市北岸的希尔克雷斯特（Hillcrest）郊区。

sentences.en: The phone stopped ringing before Christy could answer it.
sentences.zh: 没等克里斯蒂接听，电话铃声就停了。

sentences.en: She hadn't gotten to it in time.
sentences.zh: 她没来得及接起。

sentences.en: But then, a few seconds later, it started ringing again.
sentences.zh: 但几秒钟后，电话又响了起来。

sentences.en: This time, Christy picked up the receiver and said,
sentences.zh: 这一次，克里斯蒂拿起话筒说道：

sentences.en: A male voice on the other end asked to speak with her.
sentences.zh: 电话那头的一个男声要求和她通话。

sentences.en: This is Christy, she replied.
sentences.zh: “我是克里斯蒂，”她回答道。

sentences.en: It turned out that the caller was an acquaintance of hers named Akshay Chand.
sentences.zh: 原来打电话的人是她认识的一个熟人，名叫阿克沙伊·钱德（Akshay Chand）。

sentences.en: Up until recently, the pair had both worked at the same local supermarket.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，两人都曾在当地同一家超市工作。

sentences.en: They weren't close, but they were friendly, chatting during their shifts and sometimes talking outside of work via Facebook Messenger.
sentences.zh: 他们虽然不算亲密，但也算友好，在值班时会聊天，有时也会通过脸书信使（Facebook Messenger）在工作之外交流。

sentences.en: They lived just a few blocks from one another, and Chand had been over to Christy's house on several occasions.
sentences.zh: 他们的住处只相隔几个街区，钱德曾多次去过克里斯蒂家。

sentences.en: He often needed someone to speak with about his personal probleMs.
sentences.zh: 他经常需要找人倾诉自己的个人烦恼。

sentences.en: Kind and open-hearted, Christy was always willing to listen.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂心地善良、性格开朗，总是愿意倾听。

sentences.en: Christy knew that Chand had been struggling lately, but she couldn't have anticipated what he said next.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂知道钱德最近过得很艰难，但她怎么也没想到他接下来会说出这样的话。

sentences.en: Her heart sank as he stated,
sentences.zh: 当他说道时，她的心沉了下去：

sentences.en: I put 40 pills into a drink and I've crushed them all.
sentences.zh: 我把40片药放进饮料里了，而且全部碾碎了。

sentences.en: And if you don't get to my house within 10 minutes, I'm going to drink them.
sentences.zh: 如果你在10分钟内不到我家，我就把它们喝下去。

sentences.en: Without hesitating, Christy headed over to help Chand.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂没有犹豫，立刻动身去帮助钱德。

sentences.en: Christy Marceau had been in such a rush after receiving Akshay Chand's call that she barely had time to get dressed.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂·马索在接到阿克沙伊·钱德的电话后急得团团转，几乎没有时间换衣服。

sentences.en: She hastily pulled on a pair of black tracksuit pants and a jumper over the blue top, bra, and bikini bottoms that she'd been sleeping in.
sentences.zh: 她匆忙套上一条黑色运动裤和一件套头衫，穿在她睡觉时穿的蓝色上衣、文胸和比基尼泳裤外面。

sentences.en: Then she grabbed her keys and mobile phone, ran outside to her car, and drove the one-kilometre journey to Chand's home.
sentences.zh: 然后她抓起钥匙和手机，跑到车上，驱车行驶了一公里来到钱德的家。

sentences.en: It wasn't in Christy's nature to ignore a cry for help.
sentences.zh: 忽视求救信号绝不是克里斯蒂的性格。

sentences.en: She harboured a soft spot for those who found life more difficult.
sentences.zh: 她对那些生活过得比较艰难的人总是心存怜悯。

sentences.en: Once, during high school, she'd noticed a younger boy standing all alone.
sentences.zh: 有一次在高中时，她注意到一个年幼的男孩独自一人站着。

sentences.en: When Christy asked if he was alright, the boy told her he had no friends.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯蒂问他是否还好时，男孩告诉她自己没有朋友。

sentences.en: Christy took it upon herself to introduce him to a group of students his age and helped him make conversation with them.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂主动把他介绍给了一群同龄学生，并帮他融入他们的对话。

sentences.en: The boy's mother later called the school to pass along her thanks to Christy.
sentences.zh: 男孩的母亲后来给学校打电话，向克里斯蒂表达谢意。

sentences.en: Her deep sense of compassion had also led Christy to volunteer for an animal welfare charity and organise fundraisers aimed at ending world hunger.
sentences.zh: 她强烈的同情心还促使克里斯蒂去动物福利慈善机构做志愿者，并组织旨在消除世界饥饿的筹款活动。

sentences.en: She had a wide circle of friends from all walks of life that she socialised with often.
sentences.zh: 她有着广泛的朋友圈，朋友来自各行各业，她经常与他们社交。

sentences.en: Unlike Christy, Akshay Chand had a very small circle of friends.
sentences.zh: 与克里斯蒂不同，阿克沙伊·钱德的朋友圈非常小。

sentences.en: He was extremely intelligent but socially awkward, especially around women.
sentences.zh: 他极其聪明，但在社交方面却很笨拙，尤其是在女性面前。

sentences.en: He and his family had emigrated to New Zealand from Fiji when he was four years old.
sentences.zh: 他四岁时和家人从斐济移民到新西兰。

sentences.en: As children, Chand and Christy were in the same year at Willow Park Primary School, but they didn't really know one another.
sentences.zh: 小时候，钱德和克里斯蒂在威洛帕克小学（Willow Park Primary School）同年级，但他们并不是真的很熟。

sentences.en: They went on to attend different high schools and didn't meet again until they finished school and got jobs at the same supermarket.
sentences.zh: 后来他们上了不同的高中，直到毕业并在同一家超市找到工作后才再次相遇。

sentences.en: Christy behind a checkout and Chand at the meat counter.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂在收银台工作，钱德在肉食柜台。

sentences.en: Christy was kind and friendly and as they spent more time working together,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂善良友好，随着他们一起工作的时间越来越长，

sentences.en: Chand began to confide in her.
sentences.zh: 钱德开始向她吐露心声。

sentences.en: The truth was he was depressed and felt miserable about his life.
sentences.zh: 事实是，他很沮丧，对自己的生活感到痛苦。

sentences.en: He wasn't close with his family and felt directionless when it came to his future.
sentences.zh: 他和家人并不亲近，对自己的未来感到迷茫。

sentences.en: Christy felt sorry for Akshay Chand, but his attention towards her had started to feel a little intense.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂对阿克沙伊·钱德感到同情，但他对她的关注开始让她觉得有点过于热烈了。

sentences.en: In June 2011, she left her position at the supermarket for a new job at a cheese shop.
sentences.zh: 2011年6月，她辞去了超市的工作，到一家奶酪店担任新职。

sentences.en: Without work throwing them together, she saw a lot less of Chand.
sentences.zh: 没有了工作上的朝夕相处，她见到钱德的次数少了很多。

sentences.en: By the time he called her on the morning of September 6, it had been a while since the pair had spoken.
sentences.zh: 到9月6日上午他给她打电话时，两人已经有一段时间没说话了。

sentences.en: Christy knew how he'd been struggling.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂深知他一直以来的挣扎。

sentences.en: Surely, if he was calling her threatening suicide, then he was in serious trouble.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果他打电话来扬言自杀，那他一定遇到了大麻烦。

sentences.en: It only took a few minutes for Christy to arrive at the apartment building where Chand lived with his mother and younger sister.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂只花了几分钟就到达了钱德与母亲和妹妹同住的公寓楼。

sentences.en: She parked her car on the street and walked up the steps to knock on the property's screen door.
sentences.zh: 她将车停在街边，走上台阶去敲房子的纱门。

sentences.en: Chand answered and invited her in.
sentences.zh: 钱德应门并邀请她进去。

sentences.en: Christy followed him through the front door, which he locked behind them.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂跟着他穿过前门，他在他们身后把门锁上了。

sentences.en: There was no one else home.
sentences.zh: 家里没有其他人。

sentences.en: Chand's mother was working and his 16-year-old sister was at school.
sentences.zh: 钱德的母亲在上班，他16岁的妹妹在学校。

sentences.en: As the two teenagers sat down in two chairs facing one another,
sentences.zh: 当这两个年轻人坐下面对面互相对视的两把椅子上时，

sentences.en: Christy noticed some white powder on a benchtop.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂注意到台面上有一些白色粉末。

sentences.en: It looked as though it had been left after someone had crushed up some pills.
sentences.zh: 看起来就像是有人把药片碾碎后留下的。

sentences.en: Clearly, Chand was serious when he said he'd prepared a drink laced with medication.
sentences.zh: 显然，昌德说他准备了一杯掺了药的饮料时是认真的。

sentences.en: Christy asked him where the drink was.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂问他饮料在哪里。

sentences.en: Do you think I am stupid, he replied.
sentences.zh: 你觉得我很蠢吗？他反问道。

sentences.en: I obviously hid it because I knew that you'd find it.
sentences.zh: 我显然把它藏起来了，因为我知道你会找到它。

sentences.en: Then he began rambling, telling Christy how he had some specific aims and a task he'd been planning for the day.
sentences.zh: 接着他开始语无伦次地唠叨，告诉克里斯蒂他有一些具体的目标以及他那天一直在计划的任务。

sentences.en: Concerned, Christy encouraged him to get some professional help.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂感到担忧，鼓励他去寻求专业帮助。

sentences.en: This advice upset Chand.
sentences.zh: 这个建议惹恼了昌德。

sentences.en: The way he saw it, Christy had hardly been there for him since she'd left the supermarket.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，自打离开超市以后，克里斯蒂就几乎没怎么陪过他。

sentences.en: He began ranting, accusing her of not even trying to be his friend.
sentences.zh: 他开始大声抱怨，指责她甚至没有尝试去当他的朋友。

sentences.en: Christy explained that she'd been busy with her university studies and her new job.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂解释说，她一直忙于大学学业和新工作。

sentences.en: Chand retorted that she could have taken five minutes to contact him on Facebook and that would have been enough.
sentences.zh: 昌德反驳说，她本可以花五分钟在脸书上联系他，那就足够了。

sentences.en: Then he added,
sentences.zh: 接着他补充道，

sentences.en: Let's face it, we both know that you haven't been very busy.
sentences.zh: 面对现实吧，我们心里都清楚，你根本就没那么忙。

sentences.en: Christy was growing nervous.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂开始感到紧张。

sentences.en: The more Chand badgered her about why she hadn't attempted to help him, the more she tried to explain that she wasn't in a position to do so.
sentences.zh: 昌德越是纠缠她为什么不试图帮他，她就越是极力解释说自己无能为力。

sentences.en: He needed to see a mental health professional.
sentences.zh: 他需要去看心理健康专家。

sentences.en: Chand responded that he didn't need that at all.
sentences.zh: 昌德回应说，他根本不需要那个。

sentences.en: What he needed was Christy's help.
sentences.zh: 他需要的是克里斯蒂的帮助。

sentences.en: Then he told her that he had cervical cancer.
sentences.zh: 然后他告诉她，他得了宫颈癌。

sentences.en: Christy disputed this, informing him that only females could get that disease.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂对此提出异议，告诉他只有女性才会得这种病。

sentences.en: Chand abruptly changed his story, claiming he had prostate cancer instead.
sentences.zh: 昌德突然改口，声称自己得的是前列腺癌。

sentences.en: Making up stories about having cancer was too much for Christy.
sentences.zh: 编造自己得癌症的事让克里斯蒂忍无可忍。

sentences.en: It was a serious illness, not something to use to get attention.
sentences.zh: 这是一场严重的疾病，而不是用来博取关注的工具。

sentences.en: She told Chand as much.
sentences.zh: 她把这些话原封不动地告诉了昌德。

sentences.en: His expression grew angry and he stood from his chair, looming over her.
sentences.zh: 他的表情变得愤怒，从椅子上站起身，居高临下地逼近她。

sentences.en: Suddenly, he reached into the back waistband of his tracksuit pants and pulled out a long kitchen knife.
sentences.zh: 突然，他把手伸进运动裤后腰，掏出一把长长的厨房用刀。

sentences.en: The knife was about 20 centimetres long and very sharp.
sentences.zh: 这把刀大约二十厘米长，非常锋利。

sentences.en: Chand's right fist tightly held its handle as he waved it over Christy.
sentences.zh: 昌德的右手紧紧握着刀柄，在克里斯蒂面前挥舞着。

sentences.en: This is how it's gonna go, he said.
sentences.zh: 事情会是这样的，他说。

sentences.en: If you scream, I'm gonna knife you.
sentences.zh: 如果你尖叫，我就捅死你。

sentences.en: Christy began to sob, which prompted Chand to tell her to shut up and calm down.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂抽泣起来，这促使昌德命令她闭嘴并冷静下来。

sentences.en: She was still holding her mobile phone in one hand and thought about texting her best friend for help.
sentences.zh: 她手里依然握着手机，考虑着给好朋友发短信求救。

sentences.en: But Chand noticed the device and demanded, give me your phone.
sentences.zh: 但昌德注意到了这部设备并喝令道，把手机给我。

sentences.en: Christy held onto it tightly.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂死死抓住手机不放。

sentences.en: Chand tried to wrestle it out of her hand, saying,
sentences.zh: 昌德试图把手机从她手里抢过来，说道，

sentences.en: We can either do this the hard way or the easy way.
sentences.zh: 我们既可以来硬的，也可以来软的。

sentences.en: You know what you'll get if you don't give it to me.
sentences.zh: 你知道不交出来会有什么下场。

sentences.en: He succeeded in prising the phone away from Christy and placed it out of her reach.
sentences.zh: 他成功地把手机从克里斯蒂手中夺走，并把它扔到了她够不着的地方。

sentences.en: Then he turned his attention back to the matter at hand.
sentences.zh: 然后他把注意力重新转回手头的事情上。

sentences.en: As he started explaining to Christy, Chand had several things he wanted to accomplish that day.
sentences.zh: 正如他开始向克里斯蒂解释的那样，昌德那天有几件事情想要完成。

sentences.en: First, he wanted to terrify her.
sentences.zh: 首先，他想吓唬她。

sentences.en: Next, he wanted to enact revenge against her for abandoning him.
sentences.zh: 其次，他想对抛弃他的行为实施报复。

sentences.en: And finally, once those missions were complete, he would take his own life.
sentences.zh: 最后，一旦这些使命完成，他就会自寻短见。

sentences.en: Christy continued to cry.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂继续哭泣。

sentences.en: Chand ordered her to remove her jumper and hand it to him.
sentences.zh: 昌德命令她脱下套头衫并交给他。

sentences.en: She did, and once the garment was in his hands, he rummaged through its pockets.
sentences.zh: 照办后，一旦衣服到了他手里，他便开始搜翻它的口袋。

sentences.en: After finding them empty, Chand demanded Christy take off the blue top she was wearing as well.
sentences.zh: 发现口袋空空后，昌德又要求克里斯蒂脱掉她身上穿的蓝色上衣。

sentences.en: Christy refused.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂拒绝了。

sentences.en: You know what will happen if you don't do it, Chand warned.
sentences.zh: 你知道如果不照做会发生什么，昌德警告道。

sentences.en: Christy pulled the top off over her head and passed it to Chand.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂将上衣从头上脱下并递给了昌德。

sentences.en: Then he told her to stand up and prove that she wasn't hiding any objects in her tracksuit pants.
sentences.zh: 接着他叫她站起来，证明她没有在运动裤里藏任何物品。

sentences.en: Christy did so, emptying both pockets.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂照做了，掏空了两个口袋。

sentences.en: He then told her to remove her pants.
sentences.zh: 随后他命令她脱掉裤子。

sentences.en: Christy refused and cried even harder.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂拒绝了，哭得更加厉害。

sentences.en: Again, Chand threatened her with the knife.
sentences.zh: 昌德再次用刀威胁她。

sentences.en: Chand gathered all of her clothes and bundled them into a pile before taking a seat in an armchair.
sentences.zh: 昌德收起她所有的衣服并打包成堆，然后在一张扶手椅上坐下。

sentences.en: He began talking again.
sentences.zh: 他又开始说话了。

sentences.en: His rantings were confusing and bizarre.
sentences.zh: 他的胡言乱语令人困惑且荒诞不经。

sentences.en: Sometimes, he discussed the economic system of capitalism at length.
sentences.zh: 有时，他长篇大论地讨论资本主义经济系统。

sentences.en: Then he'd switch to talking about spiritual matters like God and the devil.
sentences.zh: 接着他又会转而谈论上帝和魔鬼之类的精神话题。

sentences.en: According to Chand, the devil had tried to grab him one night, and ever since then, he'd been fighting a losing battle against evil.
sentences.zh: 据昌德所说，魔鬼曾在一个晚上试图抓他，从那以后，他一直在进行一场对抗邪恶且注定失败的战斗。

sentences.en: He rambled on and on, complaining that people like Christy caused others to suffer.
sentences.zh: 他喋喋不休地抱怨，埋怨像克里斯蒂这样的人给别人造成了痛苦。

sentences.en: Chand accused her of only being there for him when it was too late, saying,
sentences.zh: 昌德指责她只有在为时已晚的时候才会出现在他身边，说道，

sentences.en: When I needed help, you were too busy, and then when I finally make this desperate call to you, you're here.
sentences.zh: 当我需要帮助时，你忙得不可开交；而当我终于给你这个绝望的电话时，你倒是在这儿了。

sentences.en: By now, more than half an hour had passed since Christy had arrived at the apartment.
sentences.zh: 此时，距离克里斯蒂抵达公寓已经过去半个多小时了。

sentences.en: Terrified, she asked,
sentences.zh: 她吓得魂飞魄散，问道，

sentences.en: Are you going to kill me?
sentences.zh: 你打算杀了我吗？

sentences.en: Chand reminded Christy of the three aims he'd had for the day.
sentences.zh: 昌德提醒克里斯蒂他当天的三个目标。

sentences.en: To scare her, to get revenge, and to kill himself.
sentences.zh: 吓唬她、报复她以及自杀。

sentences.en: He'd never said how he intended to have revenge, but now he was ready to tell her.
sentences.zh: 他从未说过他打算如何进行报复，但现在他准备好告诉她了。

sentences.en: He planned to rape her.
sentences.zh: 他计划强暴她。

sentences.en: Christy burst into tears again, prompting Chand to tell her to compose herself.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂再次放声大哭，这促使昌德叫她收敛情绪。

sentences.en: Then, all of a sudden, he changed his mind.
sentences.zh: 接着，突然之间，他改变了主意。

sentences.en: Abruptly, he told Christy that she could leave.
sentences.zh: 突然，他告诉克里斯蒂可以走了。

sentences.en: He returned her clothes and mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 他把衣服和手机还给了她。

sentences.en: Still petrified, Christy didn't trust Chand's unexpected change of heart.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂依然惊魂未定，不相信昌德会突然回心转意。

sentences.en: What if he planned to catch her off guard by stabbing her as soon as she turned her back?
sentences.zh: 万一他打算趁她一转身就捅她一刀，搞她个措手不及呢？

sentences.en: She aired this fear, prompting Chand to put the knife down.
sentences.zh: 她把这个担忧说了出来，这促使昌德把刀放下了。

sentences.en: I'm gonna let you go, he said.
sentences.zh: 我要放你走，他说。

sentences.en: But I just want you to know that once you leave, I'm gonna drink the drink I made.
sentences.zh: 但我只是想让你知道，你一走，我就会喝下我调的饮料。

sentences.en: Christy briefly paused, trying to convince Chand not to do it.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂短暂地停顿了一下，试图劝说昌德不要这样做。

sentences.en: Despite what he'd put her through, her conscience wouldn't allow her to just walk away when he said that.
sentences.zh: 尽管他让她经历了这一切，但当他说出这话时，良知不允许她就这样一走了之。

sentences.en: But Chand was insistent.
sentences.zh: 但昌德态度坚决。

sentences.en: Too scared to stay a minute longer, Christy turned and ran out of the apartment.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂吓得一分一秒也不敢多留，转身跑出了公寓。

sentences.en: She raced down the stairs that led to ground level and over to her car.
sentences.zh: 她冲下通往地面的楼梯，跑向自己的汽车。

sentences.en: Other people were out and about, strolling along the footpath with no idea of what had just happened to her.
sentences.zh: 外面有人在走动，沿着人行道漫步，对刚刚发生在她身上的事一无所知。

sentences.en: Christy thought about asking one of them for help, but she knew she wouldn't feel safe until she was back in her own home.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂曾想向其中某个人求助，但她知道，只有回到自己家里，她才会感到安全。

sentences.en: Once she was in the driver's seat, Christy locked her car doors and started the engine.
sentences.zh: 一坐进驾驶座，克里斯蒂就锁上车门，发动了汽车。

sentences.en: Then she made her way home.
sentences.zh: 然后她开车回了家。

sentences.en: As far as Christy's parents were concerned, she had been their miracle baby.
sentences.zh: 在克里斯蒂的父母看来，她是他们眼中的奇迹宝宝。

sentences.en: Shortly after having their first child, a girl they named Heather, Tracy and Brian Marceau tried to conceive again.
sentences.zh: 在生下第一个孩子——一个名叫希瑟的女孩后不久，特蕾西和布莱恩·马索夫妇就尝试再次怀孕。

sentences.en: It had taken them six long years before Christy was born and their family was complete.
sentences.zh: 他们等了漫长的六年，克里斯蒂才出生，他们的家庭也因此圆满。

sentences.en: Heather and Christy looked the same, but they had very different personalities.
sentences.zh: 希瑟和克里斯蒂长得很像，但性格却截然不同。

sentences.en: Where Heather was quiet and serious, Christy was bubbly and mischievous.
sentences.zh: 希瑟安静严肃，克里斯蒂则活泼淘气。

sentences.en: Despite these differences, and the years between them, the two sisters loved each other dearly.
sentences.zh: 尽管存在这些差异，而且年龄相差好几岁，但姐妹俩深爱着彼此。

sentences.en: By 2011, the close-knit Marceau family was somewhat scattered.
sentences.zh: 到了2011年，这个关系紧密的马索一家有些四散各处了。

sentences.en: Heather had moved out of home years earlier, while Brian worked at a mine in South Australia.
sentences.zh: 希瑟几年前就搬出了家，而布莱恩则在南澳大利亚的一座矿山工作。

sentences.en: He would fly there for weeks at a time and return home to New Zealand when he could.
sentences.zh: 他会一去就是几周，一有机会就回新西兰的家。

sentences.en: Tracy planned to move to Adelaide in the new year so she could be closer to her husband.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西计划在新年搬到阿德莱德，以便离丈夫近一些。

sentences.en: Christy wanted to go too.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂也想去。

sentences.en: She would transfer to an Australian university and was excited at the prospect of living in a new city.
sentences.zh: 她准备转学到一所澳大利亚的大学，对在一个新城市生活充满期待。

sentences.en: On the morning of Christy's attack, Tracy was busy at work when her mobile started ringing at around 11.30.
sentences.zh: 在克里斯蒂遭遇袭击的那天早上，特蕾西正在忙工作，大约11点30分时，她的手机响了起来。

sentences.en: Glancing down at its screen, she saw that her mother, Shirley, was calling.
sentences.zh: 她扫了一眼屏幕，发现是母亲雪莉打来的。

sentences.en: Shirley lived with her and granddaughter Christy in a self-contained flat on their house's lower level.
sentences.zh: 雪莉和她以及孙女克里斯蒂一起住在他们房子底层的一套独立公寓里。

sentences.en: Tracy answered the call.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西接了电话。

sentences.en: She could hear Christy crying hysterically in the background.
sentences.zh: 她能听到背景里克里斯蒂歇斯底里地哭泣声。

sentences.en: Then Tracy heard her mother's voice.
sentences.zh: 接着特蕾西听到了母亲的声音。

sentences.en: Love, I think you had better come home.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，我想你最好回家一趟。

sentences.en: Christy has been attacked.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂遭到袭击了。

sentences.en: Tracy immediately left work and was home within 15 minutes.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西立刻放下工作，在15分钟内赶回了家。

sentences.en: Upon seeing her mother, Christy embraced her and wouldn't let go.
sentences.zh: 一看到母亲，克里斯蒂就紧紧抱住她，怎么也不肯松手。

sentences.en: Sobbing and shaking the entire time, she told Tracy what Akshay Chant had done to her.
sentences.zh: 她全程泣不成声、浑身颤抖，向特蕾西讲述了阿克沙伊·昌德对她做的事。

sentences.en: Tracy didn't know Chant well.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西并不太了解昌德。

sentences.en: He certainly wasn't one of Christy's friends, though she had mentioned his name after she started working at the supermarket with him.
sentences.zh: 他绝对算不上克里斯蒂的朋友，不过自从她开始和他在超市工作后，她曾提起过他的名字。

sentences.en: Christy had described him as a lonely boy with few friends.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂曾形容他是一个没什么朋友的孤独男孩。

sentences.en: One Sunday a few months earlier, Tracy and Christy returned home after driving Brian to the airport and found Chant waiting in their driveway.
sentences.zh: 几个月前的一个星期天，特蕾西和克里斯蒂开车送布莱恩去机场后回到家，发现昌德正在她们的的车道上等着。

sentences.en: Christy chatted with him for a little while, then he went home.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂和他聊了一会儿，然后他就回家了。

sentences.en: Christy had reassured her mother that Chant just needed to speak to someone who was nice to him.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂曾安慰母亲说，昌德只是需要和对她好的人说说话。

sentences.en: But his behaviour unnerved Tracy.
sentences.zh: 但他的行为让特蕾西感到不安。

sentences.en: There was something about the teenager that made her deeply uncomfortable.
sentences.zh: 这个少年身上有一种说不出的特质，让她感到极其不舒服。

sentences.en: She asked Christy not to speak to him anymore.
sentences.zh: 她要求克里斯蒂不要再跟他说话。

sentences.en: Christy was adamant that he was nothing to worry about and there were no more incidents that Tracy was aware of until the assault in his home that morning.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂坚称他没什么好担心的，在今天早上他家里的那起袭击发生之前，特蕾西也没有再听说过任何别的事件。

sentences.en: The details of what had happened to her daughter devastated, terrified and sickened Tracy.
sentences.zh: 女儿所遭受的袭击细节让特蕾西感到痛心、恐惧和作呕。

sentences.en: She took Christy to North Shore Police Station to file an official complaint.
sentences.zh: 她带着克里斯蒂前往北岸警察局正式报案。

sentences.en: Christy recounted her ordeal again for the police.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂向警方再次复述了她的遭遇。

sentences.en: She revealed that during the assault, she'd been able to hear the voices of Akshay Chant's neighbours next door.
sentences.zh: 她透露，在遇袭期间，她能听到阿克沙伊·昌德隔壁邻居的声音。

sentences.en: She'd deliberately tried to cry loudly, hoping they might hear her.
sentences.zh: 她曾故意大声哭泣，希望能被他们听到。

sentences.en: She had also tried to placate Chant by agreeing with him when he told her how awful she was.
sentences.zh: 当昌德说她有多糟糕时，她还通过表示赞同来试图安抚昌德。

sentences.en: A strategy she'd learned about while watching police procedural programs like Criminal Minds.
sentences.zh: 这是一种她从收看《犯罪心理》等警察破案节目中学到的策略。

sentences.en: Christy had considered trying to escape by running for the front door.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂曾考虑过冲向大门逃跑。

sentences.en: But it was locked, and she knew that if she fumbled or Chant caught up to her, she'd be in trouble.
sentences.zh: 但门是锁着的，她知道如果自己慌乱失措或者被昌德追上，她就死定了。

sentences.en: She even wondered if she should let Chant stab her just once.
sentences.zh: 她甚至想过，是不是应该让昌德捅自己一下就好。

sentences.en: Perhaps if he did, the reality of the violence would have snapped him out of whatever he was thinking.
sentences.zh: 也许如果他真的这么做了，暴力的现实就会让他从种种胡思乱想中清醒过来。

sentences.en: Then she would have been free to leave and see her family again.
sentences.zh: 然后她就可以重获自由，离开并再次见到家人了。

sentences.en: Christy had no idea why Chant had suddenly changed his mind and let her go.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂根本不知道昌德为什么会突然改变主意放她走。

sentences.en: But she was convinced it wasn't over and that he might attack her again.
sentences.zh: 但她确信事情还没结束，他可能会再次袭击她。

sentences.en: She revealed that Chant had actually been stalking her for a while.
sentences.zh: 她透露，昌德其实已经尾随她一段时间了。

sentences.en: Unbeknownst to her parents, she'd come home to find him sitting on her doorstep more than once.
sentences.zh: 瞒着父母，她不止一次回到家时发现他坐在她家的门阶上。

sentences.en: He had also followed her home after a work party where he'd gotten very drunk.
sentences.zh: 在一次公司聚会后，他喝得酩酊大醉，也曾一路跟踪她回家。

sentences.en: Not long after that, he left a note in the letterbox in which he confessed his love for her and insisted that she help him by becoming his counsellor.
sentences.zh: 那不久之后，他在信箱里留下一张纸条，在上面表白了对她的爱，并坚持要求她做他的心理辅导员来帮助他。

sentences.en: Chant also tried to give her a large sum of money as a gift.
sentences.zh: 昌德还试图给她一大笔钱作为礼物。

sentences.en: Christy refused to accept it, but he was insistent.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂拒绝接受，但他态度坚决。

sentences.en: She held onto it, suspecting he would ask for it back.
sentences.zh: 她把钱留下了，怀疑他还会要回去。

sentences.en: He did, a few days later.
sentences.zh: 几天后，他果然要了。

sentences.en: Chant constantly rambled to Christy about diseases he thought he had or how he hated capitalism, which he blamed for ruining his family.
sentences.zh: 昌德经常对克里斯蒂喋喋不休地谈论他认为自己患有的疾病，或者他如何痛恨资本主义，并把资本主义归咎为毁灭他家庭的罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: She was polite, but found their conversations frustrating.
sentences.zh: 她很有礼貌，但却觉得与他们的对话令人沮丧。

sentences.en: When Christy resigned from her job at the supermarket,
sentences.zh: 当克里斯蒂辞去超市的工作时，

sentences.en: Chant quit on the same day, saying he had no reason to be there if she was gone.
sentences.zh: 昌德在同一天也辞职了，理由是如果她走了，他就没有理由留在那儿了。

sentences.en: It was abundantly clear that he now harboured a lot of anger towards her.
sentences.zh: 显而易见，他现在对她怀恨在心。

sentences.en: She was terrified at the thought that he was still out there.
sentences.zh: 一想到他还逍遥法外，她就感到恐惧。

sentences.en: The police officers who took down Christy's statement understood the danger.
sentences.zh: 记录克里斯蒂口供的警官们意识到了危险。

sentences.en: Akshay Chant was unpredictable and unstable.
sentences.zh: 阿克沙伊·昌德喜怒无常、情绪不稳定。

sentences.en: They held Christy's concerns that he could strike again.
sentences.zh: 他们赞同克里斯蒂关于他可能会再次动手的担忧。

sentences.en: Detectives were quickly dispatched to his residence to place him under arreSt.
sentences.zh: 侦探们很快被派往他的住所实施逮捕。

sentences.en: After Christy had left Chant's home, he retrieved the drink he'd prepared earlier.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂离开昌德家后，他拿回了自己早先准备好的饮料。

sentences.en: He'd filled it with around 50 crushed multivitamin tablets, which he'd stolen from his mother.
sentences.zh: 他在里面塞了大约50片碾碎的复合维生素片，这些药片是从他母亲那里偷来的。

sentences.en: He had read somewhere that consuming a large quantity of multivitamins had a toxic effect on the human body.
sentences.zh: 他曾在某处看到过，大量摄入复合维生素会对人体产生毒副作用。

sentences.en: Chant had swallowed the drink, intending to end his life.
sentences.zh: 昌德吞下了这杯饮料，企图结束自己的生命。

sentences.en: Some time later, his 16-year-old sister returned home from school.
sentences.zh: 一段时间后，他16岁的妹妹放学回家。

sentences.en: Chant asked her to call an ambulance for him, and the paramedics took him to North Shore Hospital's emergency department.
sentences.zh: 昌德让她帮自己叫一辆救护车，急救人员把他送到了北岸医院的急诊科。

sentences.en: Once there, Chant was assessed by a psychiatric registrar and a nurse.
sentences.zh: 一到那里，昌德就接受了一名精神科住院医师和一名护士的评估。

sentences.en: Chant admitted to feeling depressed and unloved and said his parents couldn't care less about his struggles.
sentences.zh: 昌德承认自己感到抑郁和不被爱，并称他的父母根本不在乎他的挣扎。

sentences.en: He hadn't always felt this way.
sentences.zh: 他并非一直都是这种感觉。

sentences.en: As a child, Akshay Chant had always been quiet and shy, but enjoyed periods of happiness.
sentences.zh: 小时候，阿克沙伊·昌德一直安静而害羞，但也拥有过快乐的时光。

sentences.en: When he was 8 years old, his family had relocated to Wales for his father's work.
sentences.zh: 在他8岁时，全家为了他父亲的工作搬到了威尔士。

sentences.en: Chant flourished in the UK and would later reflect on his time there as the happiest he'd ever been.
sentences.zh: 昌德在英国过得很好，后来回忆起那段时光时，认为那是他一生中最快乐的时期。

sentences.en: But in less than 2 years, Chant moved back to New Zealand with his mother and sister.
sentences.zh: 但在不到两年的时间里，昌德和母亲、妹妹一起搬回了新西兰。

sentences.en: His father stayed behind.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲留在了当地。

sentences.en: Soon, Chant's parents had announced their plans to separate.
sentences.zh: 不久，昌德的父母宣布了分居计划。

sentences.en: After that, he had little to do with his father.
sentences.zh: 那之后，他和父亲就几乎没什么来往了。

sentences.en: The young boy was academically brilliant, with teachers describing him as smart, polite and full of potential.
sentences.zh: 这个小男孩学业极为优秀，老师们形容他聪明、有礼貌、极具潜力。

sentences.en: However, by his mid-teens, his grades were rapidly falling.
sentences.zh: 然而，到了十五六岁时，他的成绩急剧下滑。

sentences.en: Instead of going on to university as many had expected, Chant didn't even graduate his final year at school.
sentences.zh: 昌德不仅没有像许多人预期的那样上大学，甚至连高中的最后一年都没能毕业。

sentences.en: Though he had previously had a small group of close friends, his social life dwindled as he became more withdrawn, spending most of his time holed up in his bedroom.
sentences.zh: 尽管他以前有一小群密友，但随着他变得越来越孤僻，他的社交生活也逐渐萎缩，大部分时间都躲在卧室里。

sentences.en: He would read, listen to music, and play chess online.
sentences.zh: 他看书、听音乐、在网上玩国际象棋。

sentences.en: Chant became fixated with capitalism after reading Das Kapital by German philosopher and economist Karl Marx.
sentences.zh: 在读了德国哲学家、经济学家卡尔·马克思的《资本论》后，昌德对资本主义产生了执念。

sentences.en: At night, he struggled to sleep and would make up for it by staying in bed the next day.
sentences.zh: 他晚上难以入睡，第二天便躺在床上不起以此来补觉。

sentences.en: His weight fluctuated, but he never abused drugs or alcohol.
sentences.zh: 他的体重时胖时瘦，但从未滥用药物或酒精。

sentences.en: His lack of motivation led him to resisting his mother's entreaties that he resume his studies or find a job.
sentences.zh: 他缺乏动力，因而抗拒母亲劝他恢复学业或找工作的恳求。

sentences.en: Chant was exhibiting classic symptoms of depression.
sentences.zh: 昌德当时正表现出抑郁的经典症状。

sentences.en: Eventually, his aunt organised a job for him at the same supermarket where she worked.
sentences.zh: 最终，他的阿姨在他工作的同一家超市为他安排了一份工作。

sentences.en: It was there that he met Christy Marceau, one of the few girls who he felt comfortable speaking to.
sentences.zh: 正是在那里，他遇到了克里斯蒂·马索，她是少数几个让他觉得能自在交谈的女孩之一。

sentences.en: Soon, he was opening up to her about his probleMs.
sentences.zh: 不久，他便开始向她倾诉自己的烦恼。

sentences.en: Though Chant told the hospital staff how awful he'd been feeling and how rejected he felt by his peers,
sentences.zh: 尽管昌德向医院工作人员讲述了自己感觉有多么糟糕以及被同龄人排斥的感受，

sentences.en: he mentioned nothing about Christy or what he'd done to her earlier that day.
sentences.zh: 但他对克里斯蒂以及当天早些时候对她做过的事却闭口不谈。

sentences.en: The psychiatric registrar diagnosed Chant as having depression with suicidality.
sentences.zh: 精神科住院医师诊断昌德患有伴有自杀倾向的抑郁症。

sentences.en: He found no symptoms of psychosis, but made a point of writing in his notes.
sentences.zh: 他没有发现精神病症状，但在病历记录中特意写道：

sentences.en: Some grandiose or entitled flavour to his discussion, also slightly narcissistic.
sentences.zh: 谈话中带有一种宏大妄自尊大或理所当然的意味，也略带自恋。

sentences.en: He prescribed Chant with an antidepressant and referred him to a community mental health team for follow-up.
sentences.zh: 他给昌德开抗抑郁药，并将其转诊给社区心理健康团队进行跟进。

sentences.en: When the police arrived at Chant's residence, they found only his mother at home.
sentences.zh: 当警察到达昌德的住所时，家里只有他的母亲。

sentences.en: She had no idea where her son was.
sentences.zh: 她对儿子在哪儿一无所知。

sentences.en: The officers managed to track him down at North Shore Hospital, where they began to interview him.
sentences.zh: 警官们设法在北岸医院追踪到了他，并在那里开始对他进行讯问。

sentences.en: As police queried him about each stage of the attack against Christy,
sentences.zh: 当警察就对克里斯蒂袭击的每个阶段进行盘问时，

sentences.en: Chant responded to almost every question by simply saying, yeah.
sentences.zh: 昌德几乎对每个问题都只是简单地回答：嗯。

sentences.en: Within minutes, he'd admitted to everything.
sentences.zh: 在几分钟内，他就对一切供认不讳。

sentences.en: That same evening, he was charged with kidnapping, assault with intent to commit sexual violation, and threatening to do grievous bodily harm.
sentences.zh: 就在当天晚上，他被指控绑架、意图实施性侵犯的袭击以及威胁造成严重身体伤害。

sentences.en: Chant was transferred to the police station so a formal interview could take place.
sentences.zh: 昌德被移交给警察局，以便进行正式讯问。

sentences.en: He said that he'd been planning to rape Christy, but inexplicably changed his mind and decided to let her go.
sentences.zh: 他交代说，他本打算强奸克里斯蒂，但莫名其妙地改变了主意，决定放她走。

sentences.en: His motive for the entire attack had been revenge.
sentences.zh: 他整场袭击的动机是报复。

sentences.en: Chant said that he'd been furious at Christy for not helping him with his depression, and admitted to still wanting vengeance.
sentences.zh: 昌德说，他因为克里斯蒂没有帮他摆脱抑郁而对她怒火中烧，并承认自己仍然渴望复仇。

sentences.en: Although Akshay Chant had never been in trouble before, the police were extremely concerned by the violent nature of his crimes.
sentences.zh: 尽管阿克沙伊·昌德以前从未惹过麻烦，但警方对他的犯罪行为所表现出的暴力性质感到极度担忧。

sentences.en: As one of the station's detectives noted, his actions were, quite a big jump for somebody who had never offended before.
sentences.zh: 正如该局的一名侦探所指出的，对于一个从未犯罪的人来说，他的行为跨度实在是太大了。

sentences.en: Plus, he was apparently still harbouring anger towards Christy.
sentences.zh: 此外，他显然还在对克里斯蒂怀恨在心。

sentences.en: The officers were in no doubt as to what should happen next.
sentences.zh: 警官们对接下来该怎么做毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Chant should be kept in custody until the case could go to court.
sentences.zh: 在案件开庭审理之前，必须将昌德拘留。

sentences.en: Detective Sergeant James Watson prepared a document titled
sentences.zh: 侦探警长詹姆斯·沃森准备了一份题为

sentences.en: Grounds for Opposing Bail.
sentences.zh: 反对保释理由的文件。

sentences.en: In it, he detailed how Akshay Chant had admitted to attacking and detaining Christy Marceau with the intent of sexually assaulting her.
sentences.zh: 他在文件中详细说明了阿克沙伊·昌德如何承认为了实施性侵犯而袭击并扣押了克里斯蒂·马索。

sentences.en: His confession meant that a conviction was extremely likely and incarceration would be inevitable given the seriousness of his crimes.
sentences.zh: 他的供认意味着极有可能被定罪，鉴于其犯罪情节严重，入狱是不可避免的。

sentences.en: Detective Watson made a particular point of noting Christy's extreme fear of Chant and her desire that he be detained.
sentences.zh: 沃森侦探特意指出克里斯蒂对昌德的极端恐惧以及她希望将其拘押的强烈愿望。

sentences.en: The proximity of their homes to one another meant that he could be at her house within minutes if he decided to strike again.
sentences.zh: 他们两家住所相距很近，这意味着如果他决定再次动手，几分钟内就能赶到她家。

sentences.en: Three days after the attack,
sentences.zh: 袭击发生三天后，

sentences.en: Akshay Chant appeared in court.
sentences.zh: 阿克沙伊·昌德出庭受审。

sentences.en: His attorney argued her client should be granted bail as he was just 18 years old.
sentences.zh: 他的辩护律师辩称，她的当事人年仅18岁，理应获得保释。

sentences.en: The country's bail act at the time meant that defendants who were over the age of 17 but under the age of 20 must be released on bail unless they had a prior conviction.
sentences.zh: 当时该国的《保释法》规定，年龄超过17岁但未满20岁的被告，除非有前科，否则必须予以保释。

sentences.en: Chant had no previous arrests, let alone convictions.
sentences.zh: 昌德此前从未被捕过，更不用说定罪了。

sentences.en: Chant's attorney conceded that his mental health issues were a factor but explained he was about to start taking antidepressants.
sentences.zh: 昌德的律师承认他的心理健康问题是一个因素，但解释说他即将开始服用抗抑郁药。

sentences.en: If given bail, he would live with his mother so she could supervise him.
sentences.zh: 如果获得保释，他将和母亲住在一起，以便母亲监督他。

sentences.en: He would also attend a psychiatric appointment within a week of release.
sentences.zh: 他还将在获释后的一周内参加一次精神科预约。

sentences.en: The police prosecutor protested these conditions telling judge Barbara Morris that Chant's mother's home was totally inappropriate.
sentences.zh: 警方检察官抗议这些条件，向法官芭芭拉·莫里斯表示，昌德母亲的住所完全不合适。

sentences.en: If travelling by car, it was approximately one kilometre from Christy Marceau's house.
sentences.zh: 如果开车出行，它距离克里斯蒂·马索的房子大约有一公里。

sentences.en: It was even closer to reach by foot.
sentences.zh: 如果步行前往甚至更近。

sentences.en: Chant and Christy's homes sat in streets that were practically parallel to one another and just 350 metres apart.
sentences.zh: 昌德和克里斯蒂的家所在的街道几乎平行，相距仅350米。

sentences.en: Chant could cut across a reserve that separated their two blocks and be at the Marceau residence within five minutes.
sentences.zh: 恰恩可以穿过隔开他们两个街区的保留地，并在五分钟内到达马索的住所。

sentences.en: Judge Morris agreed that such an arrangement was unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯法官同意这种安排是不可接受的。

sentences.en: Despite the bail act, the only way she would consider providing bail was if Chant agreed to stay at a mental health facility.
sentences.zh: 尽管有保释法，她唯一会考虑给予保释的情况是恰恩同意入住心理健康机构。

sentences.en: However, it was unlikely such a facility would accept him as he wasn't exhibiting the sorts of symptoms
sentences.zh: 然而，这样的机构不太可能会接收他，因为他没有表现出那种

sentences.en: that required intervention in accordance with New Zealand's Mental Health Act.
sentences.zh: 根据新西兰《心理健康法》需要进行干预的症状。

sentences.en: Ultimately, Judge Morris ordered that Akshay Chant receive a full psychiatric assessment and denied him bail, citing public safety concerns and Christy Marceau's anxieties.
sentences.zh: 最终，莫里斯法官下令对阿克沙伊·恰恩进行全面的精神评估，并以公共安全和克里斯蒂·马索的担忧为由拒绝了他的保释。

sentences.en: I must take her wishes into account, Judge Morris said.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯法官说，我必须把她的愿望考虑在内。

sentences.en: I do not consider it prudent or wise to grant bail until at least a full forensic report can be obtained.
sentences.zh: 在至少获得完整的法医报告之前，我认为准予保释既不审慎也不明智。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Christy was struggling.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，克里斯蒂正在挣扎。

sentences.en: The traumatic ordeal she had suffered shattered her sense of safety and security.
sentences.zh: 她所遭受的创伤性磨难击碎了她对安全感和保障感的认知。

sentences.en: Her father Brian was still away in Australia and wouldn't be returning for almost a week.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲布莱恩当时还在澳大利亚，还要将近一周才会回来。

sentences.en: Christy knew that if she told him about the assault, he would fly home immediately.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂知道，如果她把袭击的事告诉他，他会立刻飞回家。

sentences.en: Not wanting to cause her father any distress, she decided not to tell him what had happened until he arrived back.
sentences.zh: 为了不让父亲担心，她决定等他回来后再告诉他发生了什么。

sentences.en: Christy was too scared to sleep in her own room, which sat on the lower level of her home.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂吓得不敢睡在自己位于房屋底层的房间里。

sentences.en: She initially slept beside her mother.
sentences.zh: 她最初睡在母亲旁边。

sentences.en: After two weeks, she moved into the spare room next to her parents.
sentences.zh: 两周后，她搬进了父母隔壁的客房。

sentences.en: Eventually, she was able to return to her own bed.
sentences.zh: 最终，她得以回到自己的床上睡觉。

sentences.en: But if she heard strange sounds during the night, she would ask her mum and dad to check up on them.
sentences.zh: 但如果在夜里听到奇怪的声音，她会请父母去查看。

sentences.en: Christy also no longer felt safe taking public transport.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂也再也没有勇气乘坐公共交通工具。

sentences.en: Her parents would drop her off at work or university, then collect her afterwards.
sentences.zh: 她的父母会开车送她去上班或上大学，然后再去接她。

sentences.en: She kept a diary and saw a counsellor to deal with the trauma she had been left with.
sentences.zh: 她写日记并看心理咨询师，以应对留下的心理创伤。

sentences.en: Her greatest fear was that Akshay Chand would be released.
sentences.zh: 她最大的恐惧是阿克沙伊·昌德会被释放。

sentences.en: She wasn't only scared for her own life, she was terrified he might target her family or become fixated with another girl.
sentences.zh: 她不仅为自己的生命感到害怕，还惊恐于他可能会把目标对准她的家人或对另一个女孩产生执念。

sentences.en: By early November, life was slowly starting to feel good again.
sentences.zh: 到了11月初，生活开始慢慢重新变得美好起来。

sentences.en: Chand was finally going to trial on Wednesday November 9 and in a couple of months,
sentences.zh: 昌德终于将在11月9日星期三接受审判，再过几个月，

sentences.en: Christy and her parents would be moving to Australia.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂和她的父母将搬到澳大利亚。

sentences.en: What was initially planned as an exciting new chapter was now going to be the opportunity for a much-needed fresh start.
sentences.zh: 原本计划中激动人心的崭新篇章，现在将成为一个急需重新开始的机会。

sentences.en: On the morning of Sunday November 6,
sentences.zh: 在11月6日星期日的早晨，

sentences.en: Christy and Tracey went out for brunch together.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂和特蕾西一起出去吃早午餐。

sentences.en: Christy was seeing a friend later that day but was keen to spend some quality time with her mum beforehand.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂那天晚些时候要去看望一个朋友，但在此之前她很想和妈妈度过一段美好的时光。

sentences.en: She was determined to have pancakes, so they went from cafe to cafe until they found one that had them on the menu.
sentences.zh: 她执意要吃煎饼，于是她们一家一家咖啡馆地找，直到找到一家菜单上有煎饼的。

sentences.en: As they sat and ate, the two happily discussed their upcoming plans.
sentences.zh: 当她们坐着吃东西时，两人开心地讨论着接下来的计划。

sentences.en: Tracey and Brian were planning to take Christy to see some pandas at the zoo.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西和布莱恩计划带克里斯蒂去动物园看大熊猫。

sentences.en: Christy planned to wear a panda hat she owned for the occasion.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂计划为此戴上一顶她拥有的大熊猫帽子。

sentences.en: As they chatted,
sentences.zh: 在她们聊天时，

sentences.en: Christy made a point of saying to Tracey,
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂特意对特蕾西说：

sentences.en: Mum, I love you.
sentences.zh: 妈妈，我爱你。

sentences.en: The next morning,
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，

sentences.en: Tracey got up at 6.30 to get ready for work.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西6点30分起床准备上班。

sentences.en: She let the family dogs outside, ate breakfast and took a shower.
sentences.zh: 她把家里的狗放出去，吃了早餐并冲了个澡。

sentences.en: Still wearing her dressing gown, she was preparing to get dressed for the day when there was a knock at the front door.
sentences.zh: 她身上还穿着晨衣，正准备换衣服开始新的一天，这时前门传来了敲门声。

sentences.en: It was still early, about 7am, but Tracey wasn't surprised by the knock.
sentences.zh: 当时还很早，大约早上7点，但特蕾西对敲门声并不感到意外。

sentences.en: Christy liked to shop online and her orders were usually delivered at the start of the day.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂喜欢网上购物，她的订单通常在清晨送达。

sentences.en: As Christy was still in bed, sleeping in before a late morning shift at work,
sentences.zh: 由于克里斯蒂还在睡觉，在上午晚些时候上班前补觉，

sentences.en: Tracey went to answer the door herself.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西亲自去应门。

sentences.en: Standing on the doorstep was a young man.
sentences.zh: 门廊上站着一个年轻男子。

sentences.en: Tracey didn't recognise him at firSt.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西起初没认出他。

sentences.en: Then, Tracey realised.
sentences.zh: 然后，特蕾西意识到了。

sentences.en: It was Akshay Chant.
sentences.zh: 是阿克沙伊·恰恩。

sentences.en: He was holding a knife.
sentences.zh: 他手里拿着一把刀。

sentences.en: Terror washed over Tracey as Chant pushed his way inside, brandishing the weapon at her.
sentences.zh: 恐惧瞬间席卷了特蕾西，恰恩挥舞着武器向她强行闯入。

sentences.en: She screamed as loudly as she could, hoping Christy would hear, realise something dangerous was happening and escape.
sentences.zh: 她尽最大力气尖叫，希望克里斯蒂能听到，意识到有危险的事情发生并逃跑。

sentences.en: Or maybe some neighbours would hear and call for help.
sentences.zh: 或者也许有些邻居会听到并呼叫救援。

sentences.en: Still threatening Tracey with the knife,
sentences.zh: 恰恩依然用刀威胁着特蕾西，

sentences.en: Chant asked who else was in the house.
sentences.zh: 询问家里还有谁。

sentences.en: Thinking quickly,
sentences.zh: 她急中生智，

sentences.en: Tracey told him her husband was home.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西告诉他她丈夫在家。

sentences.en: It was a lie.
sentences.zh: 这是一个谎言。

sentences.en: He had gone back to Australia for work.
sentences.zh: 他为了工作已经回到了澳大利亚。

sentences.en: Chant seemed to know this, prompting Tracey to wonder if he'd been watching them for some time.
sentences.zh: 恰恩似乎知道这一点，这让特蕾西怀疑他是否已经监视他们一段时间了。

sentences.en: Suddenly, Christy appeared on the staircase near Tracey and Chant, barefoot and wearing a t-shirt and boxer shorts.
sentences.zh: 突然，克里斯蒂出现在靠近特蕾西和恰恩的楼梯上，赤着脚，穿着T恤和平角短裤。

sentences.en: Her mother's screams had woken her and she walked up from her bedroom to see what was wrong.
sentences.zh: 母亲的尖叫声吵醒了她，她从卧室走上来查看出了什么事。

sentences.en: Upon seeing Chant,
sentences.zh: 一看到恰恩，

sentences.en: Christy screamed, oh my god.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂尖叫道，我的天哪。

sentences.en: Frozen with fear, she stood at the top of the stairs without moving.
sentences.zh: 她吓得呆立在楼梯顶端一动不动。

sentences.en: Chant continued to point the knife at Tracey while edging closer to Christy.
sentences.zh: 恰恩一边继续用刀指着特蕾西，一边向克里斯蒂逼近。

sentences.en: Then he kicked her square in the chest, sending her tumbling down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 然后他正面踢了她的胸口，把她踢得滚下了楼梯。

sentences.en: Christy fell back, then managed to get to her feet.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂向后摔倒，随后设法站起身来。

sentences.en: She scrambled down the rest of the staircase.
sentences.zh: 她跌跌撞撞地走完剩下的楼梯。

sentences.en: In her rush, she slipped and fell again.
sentences.zh: 在慌乱中，她脚底一滑又摔倒了。

sentences.en: Then she got up and ran through the self-contained flat where her grandma Shirley lived, out towards the back garden.
sentences.zh: 接着她爬起来，穿过她奶奶雪莉居住的独立公寓，跑向后花园。

sentences.en: Chant chased after her.
sentences.zh: 恰恩在后面追赶她。

sentences.en: Tracey decided to call for help.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西决定呼叫救援。

sentences.en: Given what Chant had done the last time, she thought he was intending to threaten and scare Christy.
sentences.zh: 鉴于恰恩上次所做的事情，她以为他是打算威胁和吓唬克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: Surely, once her daughter reached downstairs, she would be able to lock herself in Shirley's flat, preventing Chant from reaching her.
sentences.zh: 当然，一旦女儿到了楼下，她就能把自己反锁在雪莉的公寓里，让恰恩无法接近她。

sentences.en: The police were familiar with the case and would prioritise her call.
sentences.zh: 警察对这起案件很熟悉，会优先处理她的报警。

sentences.en: They'd be here within minutes and could arrest Chant.
sentences.zh: 他们几分钟内就会赶到，并能逮捕恰恩。

sentences.en: Panicked,
sentences.zh: 惊慌失措之下，

sentences.en: Tracey dialed emergency services.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西拨打了紧急服务电话。

sentences.en: Please send police, she begged the operator.
sentences.zh: 请派警察来，她哀求接线员。

sentences.en: There's a guy got into our house and he's after my daughter.
sentences.zh: 有个家伙闯进我们家，他正在追我女儿。

sentences.en: Just as she gave her address, she heard a scream.
sentences.zh: 就在她报出地址时，她听到了一声尖叫。

sentences.en: It was Christy.
sentences.zh: 那是克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: Tracey dropped the phone and ran downstairs.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西扔下电话跑下楼。

sentences.en: Christy was lying on the deck outside in the garden.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂躺在花园室外的露台上。

sentences.en: There was a pool of blood beneath her.
sentences.zh: 她身下一滩血迹。

sentences.en: Chant was standing nearby.
sentences.zh: 恰恩正站在附近。

sentences.en: Tracey raced to her daughter and held Christy in her arMs.

sentences.zh: 2012年9月27日，阿克沙伊·钱德对绑架、意图实施性侵犯的袭击以及威胁造成严重身体伤害的指控表示认罪。

sentences.en: A month later, he was back in
sentences.zh: 一个月后，他回到了

sentences.en: Auckland's High Court for his insanity hearing.
sentences.zh: 奥克兰高等法院出席他的精神失常听证会。

sentences.en: The experts who had assessed Chand agreed that he should be detained indefinitely as a special patient.
sentences.zh: 评估过钱德的专家们一致认为，应当将他作为特殊患者无限期拘留。

sentences.en: Because he'd been able to carry out a brutal killing and had mentioned wanting to harm others, they believed he posed a real danger to public safety.
sentences.zh: 由于他能够实施残酷的谋杀，并曾提及想要伤害他人，他们认为他对公共安全构成了真实的威胁。

sentences.en: His chances of recovery were considered low, due in part to his young age at the onset of his disease.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他发病时年龄尚轻等原因，他康复的几率被认为很低。

sentences.en: Justice Helen Wynkelman ruled that a special patient order would be made for Akshay Chand.
sentences.zh: 海伦·温克尔曼法官裁定对阿克沙伊·钱德发出特殊患者令。

sentences.en: He would be detained indefinitely at the Mason Clinic, a secure unit in
sentences.zh: 他将被无限期拘留于梅森诊所，这是

sentences.en: Auckland that provides forensic mental health services.
sentences.zh: 奥克兰一个提供法医精神健康服务的安全收容所。

sentences.en: The only way he will ever be released is if he's found to no longer be a danger to the public, an extremely unlikely possibility.
sentences.zh: 他能够获释的唯一途径是被认定不再对公众构成威胁，这是一种极不可能的可能性。

sentences.en: Justice Wynkelman also handed down a sentence for the charges relating to
sentences.zh: 温克尔曼法官还对与

sentences.en: Chand's first assault against Christy.
sentences.zh: 钱德对克里斯蒂的第一次袭击相关的指控作出了判决。

sentences.en: Because Christy wasn't able to share her story for herself, her parents had passed along her diary to Justice Wynkelman.
sentences.zh: 由于克里斯蒂无法亲自诉说她的经历，她的父母将她的日记转交给了温克尔曼法官。

sentences.en: Tracy and Brian had never read it themselves, but they knew Christy had started keeping it after the attack as a way to process her ordeal.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西和布莱恩从未自己读过这本日记，但他们知道克里斯蒂是在袭击发生后开始记日记的，以此来平复她所遭受的苦难。

sentences.en: Justice Wynkelman spoke of the insight the diary had offered into Christy's state of mind, telling Chand.
sentences.zh: 温克尔曼法官谈到了日记为人们了解克里斯蒂的心态所提供的深刻见解，并对钱德说道。

sentences.en: Following that kidnapping, it is clear she continued to be afraid of you.
sentences.zh: 在那次绑架之后，很显然她一直在害怕你。

sentences.en: She was frightened that you would return to harm her family, and that fear only increased on your release.
sentences.zh: 她害怕你会回来伤害她的家人，而这种恐惧在你获释后更是有增无减。

sentences.en: Her journal also makes clear that she regarded her life as having been fundamentally changed by what you did to her.
sentences.zh: 她的日记还清楚地表明，她认为自己的人生因为你对她所做的事情而发生了根本性的改变。

sentences.en: Justice Wynkelman then sentenced Chand to three years for kidnapping, two years for assault with intent to sexually violate, and one year for threatening to do grievous
sentences.zh: 随后，温克尔曼法官判处钱德绑架罪监禁三年、意图性侵犯袭击罪监禁两年、威胁造成严重身体

sentences.en: bodily harm.
sentences.zh: 伤害罪监禁一年。

sentences.en: He would also serve these years at the
sentences.zh: 他也将在

sentences.en: Mason Clinic.
sentences.zh: 梅森诊所服刑这些年。

sentences.en: Outside the courthouse, Tracy and Brian
sentences.zh: 在法院外，特蕾西和布莱恩

sentences.en: Marceau addressed the media.
sentences.zh: 马尔索向媒体发表了讲话。

sentences.en: Brian fought back tears as he said,
sentences.zh: 布莱恩强忍着泪水说道：

sentences.en: For us, no sentence will ever be sufficient for the loss of Christy.
sentences.zh: 对我们而言，任何刑罚都永远无法弥补失去克里斯蒂的痛苦。

sentences.en: It will never bring her back or even make us feel that justice has actually been done.
sentences.zh: 这永远无法让她死而复生，甚至无法让我们觉得正义得到了真正的伸张。

sentences.en: For us, he will always be Christy's murderer.
sentences.zh: 在我们心中，他永远是克里斯蒂的杀人犯。

sentences.en: And in our eyes, he will always be guilty.
sentences.zh: 在我们眼里，他永远是有罪的。

sentences.en: As well as viewing Chand as Christy's murderer, the Marceaus couldn't help but blame someone else for their daughter's death.
sentences.zh: 马尔索夫妇除了将钱德视为克里斯蒂的凶手之外，也不禁将女儿的死归咎于其他人。

sentences.en: They couldn't comprehend why Judge David
sentences.zh: 他们无法理解为什么大卫·麦克诺顿

sentences.en: McNaughton had approved Chand's bail application against the wishes of the police, their family, and Christy herself.
sentences.zh: 法官会在警方、他们的家人以及克里斯蒂本人的反对下批准钱德的保释申请。

sentences.en: If Chand had been kept in custody following his first violent assault, then he never would have been able to harm Christy again.
sentences.zh: 如果在第一次暴力袭击后将钱德收押，那么他根本就没有机会再次伤害克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: Much of the New Zealand public shared their concerns.
sentences.zh: 新西兰公众中有很大一部分人也有着相同的担忧。

sentences.en: News articles honed in on the fact that
sentences.zh: 新闻报道紧盯着这样一个事实：

sentences.en: Chand had been bailed to a residence just
sentences.zh: 尽管钱德曾声称想要对克里斯蒂报复，但他还是被保释到了距离克里斯蒂家只有

sentences.en: 350 metres from Christy's home, despite saying he wanted revenge against her.
sentences.zh: 350米的住所。

sentences.en: An organisation called the Sensible
sentences.zh: 一个名为理智

sentences.en: Sentencing Trust got in touch with the
sentences.zh: 量刑信托的组织与

sentences.en: Marceau family and helped them campaign to have bail laws amended.
sentences.zh: 马尔索一家取得了联系，并协助他们发起运动，要求修改保释法。

sentences.en: This led to the Bail Amendment Act being passed into New Zealand law in 2013.
sentences.zh: 这促使《保释修正案》于2013年通过并成为新西兰法律。

sentences.en: This new act put the onus on defendants to prove they weren't a threat to the community, rather than having the police argue the opposite.
sentences.zh: 这项新法案将举证责任交给了被告，要求他们证明自己对社区不构成威胁，而不是由警方来争辩相反的情况。

sentences.en: In June 2017, almost six years after Akshay
sentences.zh: 2017年6月，在阿克沙伊

sentences.en: Chand killed Christy Marceau, an inquest was held into her death to explore the circumstances that resulted in Chand being granted bail.
sentences.zh: 钱德杀害克里斯蒂·马尔索近六年之后，人们对她的死因进行了研讯，以探究导致钱德获得保释的环境和原因。

sentences.en: Judge David McNaughton, who has never spoken publicly about his decision, did not appear as a witness.
sentences.zh: 从未就其决定公开表态的大卫·麦克诺顿法官没有作为证人出庭。

sentences.en: This was due to New Zealand law preventing judges from being called to give evidence.
sentences.zh: 这是因为新西兰法律禁止传唤法官出庭作证。

sentences.en: The inquest took place over 13 days.
sentences.zh: 这项研讯持续了13天。

sentences.en: The coroner handed down a 127-page report in
sentences.zh: 验尸官在次年

sentences.en: March of the following year.
sentences.zh: 3月发布了一份127页的报告。

sentences.en: She found that Christy was let down by multiple systemic failures and a lack of collaboration between various departments and agencies.
sentences.zh: 她发现，由于多重系统性失职以及各个部门和机构之间缺乏协作，克里斯蒂被辜负了。

sentences.en: Judge Barbara Morris, the first judge to hear
sentences.zh: 芭芭拉·莫里斯法官作为审理

sentences.en: Chand's bail application, had requested that an electronic monitoring assessment be completed for Chand.
sentences.zh: 钱德保释申请的第一位法官，曾要求对钱德进行电子监控评估。

sentences.en: This involves a suspect being fitted with a GPS monitor, so their whereabouts are tracked at all times.
sentences.zh: 这涉及为嫌疑人佩戴GPS监控器，以便随时追踪他们的行踪。

sentences.en: But neither the police prosecutors nor the defence followed up on this requeSt.
sentences.zh: 但无论是警方检察官还是辩方都没有跟进这一请求。

sentences.en: Judge Morris had denied bail partially because of how close Chand's home was to Christy's.
sentences.zh: 莫里斯法官拒绝保释的部分原因，是钱德的住所距离克里斯蒂家太近了。

sentences.en: But Judge David McNaughton had not been told how close the two addresses were to each other.
sentences.zh: 但大卫·麦克诺顿法官并没有被告知这两个地址彼此相距有多近。

sentences.en: The police prosecutor who attended Chand's second bail hearing had that information, but did not share it with the judge because she felt he was uninterested in police
sentences.zh: 出席钱德第二次保释听证会的警方检察官掌握这一信息，但并没有与法官分享，因为她觉得法官对警方的

sentences.en: concerns and didn't give her an opportunity to speak.
sentences.zh: 关切不感兴趣，也没有给她发言的机会。

sentences.en: From her point of view, he had already made his mind up in favour of granting bail.
sentences.zh: 在她看来，法官已经下定决心要批准保释了。

sentences.en: Judge McNaughton was also under the impression that Chand's mother, Suchita, his sister, or his aunt, would stay with him at all times.
sentences.zh: 麦克诺顿法官还误以为钱德的母亲苏奇塔、他的姐姐或他的阿姨会全天候陪着他。

sentences.en: Chand's lawyer had mistakenly identified his sister as a university student when she was actually a juvenile who was still at school, too young to take on such a role.
sentences.zh: 钱德的律师错误地将他的姐姐描述为一名大学生，而实际上她只是一名仍在学校上学的未成年人，年龄太小，无法承担这样的角色。

sentences.en: Judge McNaughton didn't know that Suchita had consistent work commitments and that his aunt needed to be at home with her own child before school hours.
sentences.zh: 麦克诺顿法官并不知道苏奇塔有稳定的工作安排，也不知道他的阿姨在上学时间前需要在家照顾她自己的孩子。

sentences.en: Chand's family said that they had not been told that constant supervision was expected of them.
sentences.zh: 钱德的家人表示，没有人告诉他们要求他们进行持续监督。

sentences.en: The coroner also found that Chand's initial mental health reviews had been rushed and failed to provide a proper risk assessment.
sentences.zh: 验尸官还发现，钱德最初的精神健康评估过于仓促，未能提供适当的风险评估。

sentences.en: In total, she gave 10 recommendations to the Ministry of Justice, Department of
sentences.zh: 总共，她向司法部、惩教

sentences.en: Corrections, the Police, and Waitemata District Health Board in the hopes of preventing a similar tragedy in the future.
sentences.zh: 部、警方以及韦特马塔地区卫生局提出了10项建议，希望能防止未来发生类似的悲剧。

sentences.en: Tracey and Brian Marceau welcomed the coroner's findings and said the inquest had revealed to them how Christy had been failed in multiple ways.
sentences.zh: 特蕾西和布莱恩·马尔索对验尸官的调查结果表示欢迎，并称这次研讯向他们揭示了克里斯蒂是如何在多个方面遭到辜负的。

sentences.en: In an interview with Anna Leesk of the New Zealand Herald, Tracey said,
sentences.zh: 在接受《新西兰先驱报》安娜·利斯克的采访时，特蕾西说道：

sentences.en: There was more than one hand on the knife that day.
sentences.zh: 那天握着那把刀的绝不止一只手。

sentences.en: We're extremely grateful that the coroner's taken this so seriously.
sentences.zh: 我们极其感激验尸官能如此严肃地对待此事。

sentences.en: Finally, someone's on Christy's side.
sentences.zh: 总算有人站在克里斯蒂这边了。

sentences.en: In a letter she wrote to Christy one year after her death, Tracey revealed that she cried herself to sleep most nights, thinking that she had failed her daughter.
sentences.zh: 在一封写给克里斯蒂的信中，特雷西透露，在女儿死后的一年里，她几乎每晚都哭着入睡，觉得自己辜负了女儿。

sentences.en: Christy's father, Brian, has also grappled with guilt due to being overseas when his daughter was first kidnapped and later killed.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂的父亲布赖恩也一直饱受内心的折磨，因为在女儿先是被绑架后又遇害时，他正身在海外。

sentences.en: He had considered leaving his job in Australia, but police had reassured him that Christy would be safe and his family needed the income.
sentences.zh: 他曾考虑辞去在澳大利亚的工作，但警方曾向他保证克里斯蒂会很安全，而且家里也需要这笔收入。

sentences.en: In November 2012, the Marceaus set up a legacy in their daughter's name, the Christy Marceau
sentences.zh: 2012年11月，马索夫妇以女儿的名字设立了一项遗赠，即克里斯蒂·马索

sentences.en: Charitable TruSt.
sentences.zh: 慈善信托基金。

sentences.en: Through fundraising and donations, the Trust provides annual scholarships for teenagers to attend a course through Outward Bound.
sentences.zh: 通过筹款和捐赠，该信托基金每年为青少年提供奖学金，供他们参加“外展”组织（Outward Bound）的课程。

sentences.en: Christy had dreamed of completing one of the organisation's outdoor challenge courses, but never had the chance to do so.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂曾梦想完成该组织的户外挑战课程，但从未有机会实现。

sentences.en: Tracey, Brian and Christy's sister Heather have all gotten matching tattoos of Christy on their shoulders.
sentences.zh: 特雷西、布赖恩以及克里斯蒂的姐姐希瑟都在肩膀上纹了克里斯蒂的同款纹身。

sentences.en: As they told journalist Anna Leesk, these symbolise how Christy is always watching their backs.
sentences.zh: 正如他们对记者安娜·利斯所说，这些纹身象征着克里斯蒂一直在守护着他们。

sentences.en: Anna Leesk first interviewed the Marceaus just a few months after Christy's death and formed a strong friendship with them over the following year.
sentences.zh: 安娜·利斯在克里斯蒂去世几个月后首次采访了马索夫妇，并在随后的的一年里与他们结下了深厚的友谊。

sentences.en: She later collaborated with Tracey on a book titled Christy, A Family's Tragic Loss and a Mother's
sentences.zh: 她后来与特雷西合作了一本书，书名为《克里斯蒂：一个家庭的悲剧损失与一位母亲的

sentences.en: Fight for Justice.
sentences.zh: 正义之战》。

sentences.en: For Tracey, the book was a way to immortalise her daughter and tell her story.
sentences.zh: 对特雷西来说，这本书是让女儿永垂不朽并讲述她的故事的一种方式。

sentences.en: Tracey's portion of the book concludes with a letter addressed to Christy that ends with the words.
sentences.zh: 特雷西在书中的部分以一封写给克里斯蒂的信结尾，信的末尾写着这样的话。

sentences.en: The only way I can try to make sense of it is to believe that you were a special person only lent to worth for a short time to make change and spread good.
sentences.zh: 我唯一能试着去理解这件事的方式，就是相信你是一个特别的人，只是被借给这个世界一小段时间，来带来改变和传播美好。

sentences.en: As much as it is agony that we lost you so soon, I am so glad we were chosen to be your parents
sentences.zh: 尽管这么快失去你让我们痛苦万分，但我无比庆幸我们被选中成为你的父母

sentences.en: because you brought so much joy to us and I learnt so much from your beautiful kindness.
sentences.zh: 因为你给我们带来了这么多的快乐，我也从你美丽善良的品质中学到了很多。

sentences.en: I will love you to the end of time and I will use the rest of my time to continue helping people in your name.
sentences.zh: 我会爱你直到地老天荒，我将用余下的时间继续以你的名义帮助人们。

sentences.en: I know you will be proud of that.
sentences.zh: 我知道你会为此感到骄傲。
